bundle.longDescription: PortDock SCPI talks to SCPI test instruments (power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes) over a LAN raw socket (TCP 5025) or RS-232 without VISA: write, query and read with response times, *IDN? identification, error queue draining, *OPC? waits, repeated numeric measurements with a trend and CSV export, and IEEE 488.2 binary blocks with HEX preview and file save.
